description: Unit test class for ImmutableAuthorizationContext, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and authorization logic.

classes.name: ImmutableAuthorizationContextTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutableAuthorizationContext, testing its behavior regarding immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and authorization logic.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes the static JSON representation used for testing JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableAuthorizationContext is immutable and its fields are safely copied.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks that equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented for ImmutableAuthorizationContext.

methods.name: getFirstAuthorizationSubjectReturnsExpectedIfContextIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Ensures getFirstAuthorizationSubject returns the first subject when context is not empty.

methods.name: getFirstAuthorizationSubjectReturnsEmptyOptionalIfContextIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures getFirstAuthorizationSubject returns empty when context has no subjects.

methods.name: getSizeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies getSize returns the correct number of authorization subjects.

methods.name: isEmptyReturnsFalseForNonEmptyContext
methods.description: Checks isEmpty returns false for a context with subjects.

methods.name: isEmptyReturnsTrueForEmptyContext
methods.description: Checks isEmpty returns true for an empty context.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjectsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies getAuthorizationSubjects returns the correct list of subjects.

methods.name: addHead
methods.description: Tests adding subjects to the head of the context.

methods.name: addTail
methods.description: Tests adding subjects to the tail of the context.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjectIdsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that list of subject IDs matches the expected IDs.

methods.name: tryToCallIsAuthorizedWithNullGranted
methods.description: Ensures isAuthorized throws NullPointerException when granted list is null.

methods.name: tryToCallIsAuthorizedWithNullRevoked
methods.description: Ensures isAuthorized throws NullPointerException when revoked list is null.

methods.name: isNotAuthorizedForEmptyGrantedAndRevoked
methods.description: Verifies authorization with empty granted and revoked lists returns false.

methods.name: isNotAuthorizedForEmptyGranted
methods.description: Verifies authorization with empty granted list returns false.

methods.name: isAuthorizedIfSubjectIsGrantedAndRevokedIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks authorization when subject is granted and revoked list is empty.

methods.name: isNotAuthorizedIfSubjectIsGrantedAndRevoked
methods.description: Verifies that if subject is revoked, authorization returns false.

methods.name: isAuthorizedIfSubjectIsGrantedAndRevokedIsDisjoint
methods.description: Checks that disjoint granted and revoked lists permit authorization.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies toJson produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that fromJson correctly reconstructs the context from JSON.
